cand.title: México Hospitality Expo powered by HOSTELCO
cand.organizationName: Expo Guadalajara and Fira Barcelona International
cand.excerpt: High event credibility and geographic fit; current-edition accessibility is constrained by a confirmed non-hotel venue, so the opportunity is ranked for overflow/ancillary or future capture rather than assumed open inventory.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified commercially relevant organizer/intermediary contacts: Sanderson Melo Sacerdys, International Sales Executive, listed on the official event contact page; and Atenea Chevillotte Delgado, identified by co-organizer Expo Guadalajara as Director of Events at Fira Barcelona International and México Hospitality Expo. Use Sanderson for international exhibitor/delegation introductions and routing; use Atenea for organizer-level partnership and Hosted Buyer escalation. Neither is verified as the hotel-contract signatory. The local event-organization desk is available at info@mhe.mx / +52 33 1865 6427 but does not publish a person’s name.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming edition: 6–8 July 2027, 10:00–18:00, within the November 2026–May 2028 horizon. These are activity dates in the venue calendar, corroborated by the organizer content page and the international sales executive’s post-event announcement. The content page retains a stale “Programa 2026” heading but explicitly states July 2027; do not carry October 2026 dates forward. No 2028 edition was established.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: strong city/convention-hotel fit for the supplied Expo-adjacent Sheraton product, whose published profile lists 216 guestrooms and meeting facilities. Its inclusion in both 2025 and 2026 official hotel offers is stronger evidence of relevance than proximity alone. Target exhibitors, organizer staff, invited buyers and international delegations for accommodation, plus optional small briefings or hospitality functions subject to organizer approval. Resort relocation is not the thesis: the core exhibition remains at Expo Guadalajara. Historical attendance is not equivalent to overnight demand.
findings.venueCommitments: The 2027 edition is publicly scheduled at Expo Guadalajara, Salón Jalisco A y B. This is a confirmed non-hotel event venue listing, not evidence of an inspected signed contract. Exhibition-floor capture by Sheraton is not an available assumption. Neither this venue commitment nor the historical partner-hotel list establishes 2027 room-block commitments.
findings.historicalRotation: First edition: 6–8 May 2025, Expo Guadalajara, Salón Jalisco B, C, D–e, as rendered by the venue. Second edition: 6–8 October 2026, Expo Guadalajara. Upcoming: 6–8 July 2027, same destination and venue, Salón Jalisco A y B. There is no demonstrated destination rotation; dates changed across editions, so a fixed annual month must not be inferred. Rotation of any embedded association congress is not rotation of MHE.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status for July 2027: UNKNOWN; no verified open hotel RFP or published 2027 room allocation was found. Two documented historical pathways exist: direct hotel reservations using event offers/codes in 2025, and organizer-supported Hosted Buyer accommodation in a “hotel sede” in 2026. The 2026 allied-hotel page already includes Sheraton Guadalajara Expo. This is an established public hotel relationship, not merely an overflow prospect; it proves neither consumed rooms nor renewal. The Hosted Buyer page does not identify the specific hotel or accommodation contracting decision-maker.
findings.organizationStructure: A co-organized B2B hospitality trade exhibition led by Expo Guadalajara and Fira Barcelona International, through HOSTELCO, rather than an association-owned congress. Expo Guadalajara is both a co-organizer and the exhibition venue; Fira is the international co-organizer. Sector associations and their embedded meetings must not be confused with event ownership. No separately appointed accommodation PCO/DMC or hotel-buying agency was established in the reviewed material.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The 2026 “Hoteles sede” page lists Barceló Guadalajara, The Westin Guadalajara, VOCO by IHG, Sheraton Guadalajara Expo and European Life Style Executive Suites. Its dated offers refer to October 2026; the European listing has no explicit validity dates. The 2025 offer page additionally lists RIU Guadalajara, Real Inn and Hampton Inn Expo alongside Sheraton, Westin and Barceló. These are historical partner/offer sets, not verified 2027 incumbents or exclusive allocations. No sourced sell-out, overflow shortage, displaced block or unserved peak-room requirement was established.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Recommended now: have Sheraton’s sales team review its 2025 event-code and 2026 partner-offer records and actual pickup, then approach the local event desk with Sanderson and request routing to the 2027 hotel-alliance / Hosted Buyer accommodation lead. Reference Sheraton’s existing listing and ask whether the agreement renews, who contracts or pays, which dates and room nights are required, whether selection is still open, and whether a booking link/code and ancillary functions are permitted. Escalate partnership discussions to Atenea if appropriate. Offer a qualified proposal only after requirements and decision authority are confirmed; do not reuse expired rates or promise a block.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of 14 November 2026 the October 2026 edition is finished and cannot be sold as future demand. The next confirmed edition is July 2027: its exhibition venue is already named, but hotel-sourcing accessibility is unknown. Sheraton’s 2026 official hotel listing creates a renewal conversation, not evidence that July 2027 inventory is open or closed.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize retaining/reinstating Sheraton in the 2027 allied-hotel booking route, then seek a measured share of Hosted Buyer, exhibitor and organizer stays and separately approved ancillary meetings. The 2026 Hosted Buyer programme explicitly included hotel accommodation, establishing a real accommodation pathway, but not a 2027 tender. Treat overflow as conditional only; there is no published overflow evidence. Future cycles beyond July 2027 are relationship-development opportunities, not dated leads.
